steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
Peel and finely dice mango into small pieces, no larger than 1 cm.
In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder.
Add mashed banana and melted coconut oil to the bowl and stir until a soft dough forms.
Fold diced mango gently into the dough until evenly distributed.
Press dough firmly and evenly into the prepared pan using the back of a spoon.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the top is golden and the edges pull away from the pan.
Cool completely in the pan, then slice into 12 bars. Keep refrigerated up to 3 days.
